sources.entry: LangSwitcher - Keyboard layout converter for mistyped text. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/reg2005/langSwitcher) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
LangSwitcher - Open-source keyboard layout text converter for macOS.

summary.one_liner: LangSwitcher is an open-source macOS menu bar app that converts text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (e.g. "ghbdtn" to "привет") by remapping keys by physical position.
summary.what_it_does: Converts selected text between keyboard layouts on macOS, using a hotkey (double Shift or a custom shortcut). A Smart Conversion mode can work without manual selection: Greedy Line converts the whole wrong-layout phrase back to line start, Last Word converts only the last word, and Disabled requires explicit selection. It detects the source layout automatically from the system's installed input sources. Supported layouts are English (US/ABC), Russian, German, French and Spanish. Replacement works by simulating Cmd+C, transforming the text, and pasting with Cmd+V. An optional conversion log can be stored in a local SQLite database (off by default), where entries can be labeled correct/incorrect and exported as JSON.
use_cases: fix text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
switch mistyped English and Cyrillic text on Mac
replace Punto Switcher or Caramba Switcher on macOS
collect labeled layout-conversion data for ML training
how_to_run: xcodebuild test -project LangSwitcher.xcodeproj -scheme LangSwitcher -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

xcodebuild -project LangSwitcher.xcodeproj -scheme LangSwitcher -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
Or download a DMG from the Releases page, drag LangSwitcher to Applications, and grant Accessibility permission
notable: Maps characters by physical key position rather than Unicode translation tables
Greedy two-pass algorithm for converting mixed-layout lines
Optional local-only conversion log with labeling and JSON export for ML data
Clipboard-based replacement works in most text fields
caveats: Requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later and Accessibility permission; the app cannot be sandboxed
Only five layouts are currently supported (English, Russian, German, French, Spanish); new layouts require code changes
README mentions a donation address list, which is not a feature of the app itself
keywords: fix text typed in wrong language
